map.输入内压 p、半径 r、壁厚 t，求纵向应力。: Enter internal pressure p, radius r and wall thickness t to find the longitudinal stress.
map.📖 查看「由内压求纵向应力 使用指南」: View "Longitudinal Stress from Internal Pressure User Guide"
map.薄壁圆筒内压引起的轴向（纵向）应力。: Axial (longitudinal) stress of a thin-walled cylinder caused by internal pressure.
map.σl=50 MPa 恰为环向应力 100 MPa 的一半。: σl=50 MPa is exactly half of the hoop stress 100 MPa.
map.为何是环向的一半？: Why is it half the hoop?
map.纵向由封头平衡全截面压力，环向由单位长度两侧拉力平衡，几何上差 2 倍。: Longitudinal is balanced by the head over the full section, while hoop is balanced by the side tensions per unit length; geometrically the difference is a factor of 2.
map.若有轴向荷载或温差，需与内压纵向应力叠加。: If axial load or temperature difference exists, it must be combined with the internal-pressure longitudinal stress.
